messages:
chloe (AE): Heads-up: AcmeCorp POC just hit a noisy failure during a ramp. Demo tomorrow morning — can we triage now?
jamal (SE): Details? region, pool type, any request ids?
chloe (AE): Hosted in us-west1, pool acme-poc. Devon pasted two ids in the RFC: acme-20260322-a, acme-20260322-b. Burst pattern was steady 40 RPS with spikes to ~130 for 20-45s.
devon (customer): Correct. We ran a scripted load from a CI job. Script: `for i in seq 1 800; do curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat & done`
alex (SRE): Pulled host-side snippets: 
[2026-03-22T02:12:45Z] r=acme-20260322-a status=503 reason=queue_overflow queue=620 limit=600
[2026-03-22T02:12:46Z] r=acme-20260322-b status=502 reason=kernel_oom host=gpu-07
autoscaler-bot: scale_event trigger=true reason=queue>threshold current=620 threshold=600 target=7 start=2026-03-22T02:12:47Z ready=2026-03-22T02:13:35Z
jamal (SE): Two simultaneous issues: backlog exceeded and an OOM on a single host. Autoscaler triggered but estimated ready ~48s. We need quick mitigations.
maria (Eng): Short-term options: 1) enable model-fallback to redwood-medium for this customer so requests avoid the heavy kernel. 2) temporarily increase pool min_replicas to keep warm capacity. 3) route burst traffic into burstpool if available. Longer-term: reduce cold spin-up.
alex (SRE): I can flip min_replicas from 1 to 3 and enable model fallback. Cost note: small incremental cost for the demo window. Anyone object?
chloe (AE): Do it. Also tell the customer to add client-side retry with jitter for 5xx and 429. Jamal can paste a snippet.
jamal (SE): Snippet: `function send(){ curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x"}' $URL || (sleep $((RANDOM%3)); send) }` Recommend exponential backoff in prod.
devon (customer): We can patch their test harness. Curious: why did kernel OOM happen on gpu-07? Only a few concurrent sequences.
maria (Eng): redwood-large uses extra KV sharding during multi-concurrency which increases ephemeral memory; under sudden concurrent bursts a host may hit transient allocs and OOM. Fallback to a lower-memory variant removes that pressure.
alex (SRE): Done: `min_replicas=3` and `routing.fallback=[redwood-medium]` applied for acme-customer-id. Spun burstpool with 3 warm instances. Logs: `set min_replicas=3 for pool acme-poc; burstpool warm=3 ready`. Cleared the pending queue.
devon (customer): Re-running the ramp now, starting at 02:15 PT. Will report results in ~90s.
jamal (SE): Meanwhile, can we check whether routing preference caused region fallback earlier? I saw some requests hit eu-west.
maria (Eng): There was a `prefer_region:true` rule from an earlier failover test. I just set `prefer_region:false` for acme so model fallback is evaluated first.
alex (SRE): Also gathering /var/log/redwood/hosts/gpu-07/oom.log and the kernel dmesg. Pasting brief excerpt: `kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (redwood-runtime) total-vm:540000kK`. I'll attach to the ticket.
jamal (SE): If we still see OOMs after fallback, plan B is to pin requests to different instance types or lower sequence lengths in the demo.
enchloe (AE): Devon, can you confirm demo p50/p95 requirements? They asked for p50 < 120ms.
devon (customer): After the change, initial report: p50 ~78ms, p95 ~410ms. Saw ~4 transient 503s at the very start of the burst, then stable. Looks demoable.
achloe (AE): Great. Follow-ups: set default fallback for POCs, document runbook, and engineering to look at autoscale latency. Jamal, can you create the runbook snippet?
jamal (SE): Will do: add short playbook: pre-warm min_replicas, enable model fallback, enable burstpool for demos, client-side jittered backoff. Also add code sample.
maria (Eng): Filing INF-6482: reduce autoscaler cold spinup from ~45s to <20s. Adding logs and a small reproducer.
alex (SRE): Adjusted monitoring: lower queue alert threshold for POC cohorts to 400 to catch spikes earlier. Scheduling a small blast test tomorrow.
devon (customer): Thanks all, appreciate the quick help. Looks like we can proceed with the exec demo. :thumbsup:
chloe (AE): Thanks team. I'll update the deal thread and schedule a 30m retro with Acme after the demo.
